name: Thing
description: A thing: something that is, rather than something that happens or something that joins two others. A book, a sport, a city, a dish, a model of car — and a person and an agent, which are kinds of thing with a class of their own. It has a name, and everything else it has is said about it: descriptions, tags, links to whatever it belongs with. Reach for it when a thing has no more particular class here yet.

attributes.name: nature
attributes.description: What sort of thing this is, so the world can reason about it: place (a city, a country — places contain places, and what happened in one happened in the ones around it), agent (somebody or something that acts, holds roles, employs), event (it happens in time, so periods and before-and-after apply), object (a physical thing — it can be owned, and be part of another), abstraction (a language, a sport, a genre, a religion — no place, no time, nothing owns it, and it has kinds).

what_to_say: what sort of thing it is and why it is in this world — the reason the user mentioned it, not an encyclopaedia entry about it
brief: anything that is rather than happens — a book, a sport, a dish; where a thing goes when nothing narrower is here
